verses.text: I looked up again, and I saw four chariots coming out from between two mountains. The mountains were made of bronze.
The first chariot was pulled by red horses, the second by black horses,
the third by white horses, and the fourth by spotted horses. All of them were powerful.
I asked the angel who was talking with me, "What are these, my lord?"
The angel answered me, "These are the four winds of heaven. They are going out after standing before the Lord of the whole earth.
The chariot with the black horses is going toward the land of the north. The one with the white horses is following them, and the one with the spotted horses is going toward the south."
When the powerful horses went out, they were eager to go throughout the earth. And the angel said, "Go throughout the earth!" So they went throughout the earth.
Then he called out to me, "Look, those going toward the land of the north have given my Spirit rest in the land of the north."
Then the LORD gave me this message:
"Take silver and gold from the exiles Heldai, Tobijah, and Jedaiah, who have arrived from Babylon. Go that same day to the house of Josiah son of Zephaniah.
Take the silver and gold and make crowns. Set them on the head of Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest.
Tell him, 'This is what the LORD of Armies says: Here is the man whose name is the Branch. He will branch out from where he is and build the temple of the LORD.

Yes, he will build the temple of the LORD. He will be clothed with royal honor and will sit and rule on his throne. He will also be a priest on his throne, and there will be peace between the two roles.'
The crowns will be kept in the temple of the LORD as a reminder to Helem, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and Hen son of Zephaniah.
People who live far away will come and help build the temple of the LORD. Then you will know that the LORD of Armies has sent me to you. This will happen if you carefully obey the LORD your God."
